I am renting this small plot, so I must be careful with money. Beans do not need much fertilizer because they bring nitrogen from the air themselves, so I will only put a little DAP at planting and spread the manure I have from my animals. I will use the seed I saved from last year like my mother taught me, and my children and I will do most of the weeding ourselves. If the weeds get bad near harvest, I may call two neighbors to help for a few days.
